kv_contract.lifetime: Every input read must complete before the first overlapping output write; the scratch epoch is exclusive through final capture and consumer transfer.
kv_contract.completion: Two exponent writes share one address; both masks must be preserved.

consumer_component.convention: Command start is benchmark negedge before VP pin capture; elapsed counts the following posedges through done observation. Adapter ages are dut.age observed at negedge. These are not global programme dates.

kv_contract.qualification: CONSUMER COMPONENT ONLY at the pinned source: real VP dispatch/storage, D512 arithmetic and masked output readback. Source minimum 128 is an encoding bound; the measured fixed drain age is 1024.
